name: Sawaguchi Tsuyoshi
source:
Birthplace: Tokyo
Lives with his parents and younger brother.
The goalkeeper on his high school's soccer team.
He's usually polite and calm, but when he gets on the field he goes wild.
He's the type that can't say no to people's requests and whenever he has an idea he has to pursue it straightforwardly.
His dad is a salaryman and his mom runs an English teaching school in their house.
